rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Announcing changes to the National Executive on 26 February 2018, President Ramaphosa says that, pending the completion of their swearing-in as Members of the National Assembly, he intends further to appoint Mr David Mabuza as Deputy President of the Republic (with three other members); the new Ministers and Deputy Ministers are to be sworn in in Cape Town the next day.
